title: Filters vs. Facets: Definitions (Kathryn Whitenton, 16 March 2014)
supports: Fetched. Difference between filters and faceted navigation; facets suit large varied content sets; every facet needs metadata on current and future content; extra options add interaction cost

title: Product Lists and Filtering UX research
supports: Fetched. 344 sites benchmarked; 36% with harmful flaws; average site needs 35 changes; 67-90% vs 17-33% abandonment; original study of 19 sites and 700+ issues

title: Help Google understand your ecommerce site structure
supports: Fetched. Menus to categories to products; link to all products you want indexed; products only reachable by search may be missed; link best sellers from the home page; standard a href links

title: Managing crawling of faceted navigation URLs
supports: Fetched. Overcrawling risk; robots.txt, fragments, canonical and nofollow options; if indexed, & separator, consistent filter order and 404 for empty combinations

title: Product variant structured data (ProductGroup, Product)
supports: Fetched. productGroupID, variesBy, hasVariant; single-page and multi-page variant URLs; one canonical URL for the group; unique ID per variant

title: Product category
supports: Fetched. Standard Product Taxonomy; one category per product; AI category suggestion; category metafields; used for Shopify Tax, sales channels, filters and reports

title: Storefront filtering with Search & Discovery
supports: Fetched. Standard and custom filter sources; 25 filters per store; no filters on collections over 5,000 products; 100 values shown; value grouping; swatches need theme support

title: Product data specification
supports: Fetched. Required attributes; brand, GTIN and MPN rules; item_group_id and apparel attributes for BR, FR, DE, JP, UK, US and free listings; is_bundle and multipack; product highlights; 500 x 500 image minimum enforced from 31 January 2027

title: GTIN [gtin] attribute
supports: Fetched. Don't guess, invent or reuse GTINs; each variant its own GTIN; private label sends brand and MPN; omitting an existing GTIN can cause disapproval; accepted formats

title: Title [title] and structured title [structured_title] attribute
supports: Fetched. 150-character limit; key details first; variant details; describe whole bundles; no promotional text; AI-generated titles use structured_title

title: Merchant API overview
supports: Fetched. Merchant API described as a redesign of the Content API for Shopping; v1 sub-APIs. The page gives no shutdown date for the Content API

title: Catalog fields (Commerce Platform)
supports: Fetched. Required catalogue fields plus brand, GTIN or MPN; title up to 200 characters, 65 recommended; description up to 9,999 characters; item_group_id for variants, up to 100 characters

title: Inventory reports
supports: Fetched. Sell-through formula over 30 days; days of inventory remaining from 28 days of sales; ABC analysis at 80/15/5% of revenue over 28 days; percent sold; month-end inventory value

title: Press release No 152/24: Judgment in Case C-330/23, Aldi Süd (26 September 2024)
publisher: Court of Justice of the European Union
supports: Fetched (PDF). Reductions as a percentage or promotional price statement must be based on the lowest price in a period not shorter than 30 days before the reduction; Aldi Süd banana example at -23%

title: Price Indication Directive
supports: Fetched. Selling and unit prices; Article 6a on price reductions; Directive 2019/2161 adopted 27 November 2019 and applying from 28 May 2022; Article 6a guidance adopted 17 December 2021

title: Advertising FAQ's: A Guide for Small Business (April 2001, edited January 2025)
supports: Fetched. Same truthfulness standards for price comparisons and sale prices; refers to the Guides Against Deceptive Pricing; free offers; bait advertising

title: Unfair commercial practices (CMA207), published 4 April 2025, updated 18 November 2025
supports: Fetched, with the linked HTML guidance. DMCC Act provisions apply to practices from 6 April 2025; false claims about a specific price advantage can mislead; falsely limited-time offers banned; drip pricing covered as an omission of material information

title: CMA fines firms £6 million for misleading sales tactics (14 October 2026)
supports: Fetched. Wayfair £4.8 million for false time-limited deals; Appliances Direct £1.2 million including automatic opt-in to paid extras; Gold's Gym joining fee; 40% settlement discount; DMCC Act section 230(2)

title: Providing clear and accurate information about prices: summary (CMA209), updated 7 January 2026
supports: Fetched. Drip pricing illegal; mandatory fees and delivery in the total price; variable delivery; cheapest option shown until chosen; optional charges; fines up to 10% of turnover or £300,000

title: Open letter to online retailers: including mandatory delivery fees in the total price (2 November 2026)
supports: Fetched. Total including mandatory delivery at every stage; marketplaces; optional charges not hidden; four drip pricing enforcement cases with fines over £5.1 million and refunds over £1.35 million

title: CMA to boost consumer and business confidence as new consumer protection regime comes into force (7 April 2025)
supports: Fetched. DMCC consumer regime in force; CMA decides infringements directly; fines up to 10% of global turnover; fake reviews and drip pricing banned; first-year priorities

title: Trainline, Virgin Atlantic and RED Driving School investigated for drip pricing (19 August 2026)
supports: Fetched. Investigations into mandatory fees left out of upfront prices; AA, BSM and StubHub UK already fined; no conclusions reached

title: Pricing and payments (last checked 27 January 2026)
supports: Fetched. Total price including taxes and charges up front; extra services need explicit consent; a pre-ticked box is not consent

title: Product bundles
supports: Fetched. A bundles app is needed; Online Store, Shop and POS; only fixed bundles on Google and YouTube; bundles commonly discounted

title: Cart abandonment rate statistics (updated 28 October 2026)
supports: Fetched. 70.22% average of 50 studies 2006-2025; US checkout abandonment reasons: extra costs 40%, slow delivery 20%, couldn't see total up front 12%

title: Consumer Reviews and Testimonials Rule: Questions and Answers (November 2024)
supports: Fetched. Rule effective 21 October 2024; bans fake reviews, sentiment-conditioned incentives and review suppression; businesses may organise reviews but not suppress them

title: Fashion Nova will pay $4.2 million as part of settlement of FTC allegations it blocked negative reviews (25 January 2022)
supports: Fetched. Review management interface held reviews under four stars; not posted from late 2015 to November 2019; $4.2 million

title: Short guide for businesses: publishing consumer reviews and complying with consumer protection law (CMA208, 4 April 2025)
supports: Fetched. Fake and concealed incentivised reviews banned; review publishers need a policy, risk assessment and reasonable and proportionate steps

title: Returns: your rights when you buy online (last checked 28 April 2026)
supports: Fetched. 14-day right of withdrawal for online purchases; exception for digital content once download or streaming starts after express agreement

title: UX Guidelines for Ecommerce Product Pages (Katie Sherwin, 24 November 2019)
supports: Fetched. Consistent information across variants; shipping costs shown on the product page affect comparisons; price including product-specific charges
